card.name: The word at after a verb
card.fires_on: The word "at" right after a verb or clause, in older narrative or historical prose. It often begins a place or manner phrase such as "at once", "at all" or "at Chicago".

modes.description: "at" introduces a named place after a verb such as entered or prevailed.
